report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. Only one ERROR span (gateway call inventory, 957ms) hints at a downstream issue, insufficient to bound a root cause. No candidate is evidence-supported; hand off for deeper per-service telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms, contradicting the alert; need metrics confirming elevated error rate/latency
Need order and inventory service metrics/traces to localize the failing hop
Need inventory-to-redis latency/timeout telemetry to test redis-timeout
Need order-to-postgresql pool metrics to test db-pool-exhaustion
Need error logs from gateway/order/inventory explaining the ERROR span
